Critter Call generates speech from this audio bank, using per-character pitch.
The audio bank is distributed unchanged. The engine has a small local change
to report audio-loading errors, reject failed responses, and validate its bank.
Generated speech is adapted audio; credit Josh Simmons when redistributing it.

riffwave.js v0.03 is public domain, by Pedro Ladaria (2011).
riffwave.js has a local correction to the generated WAV byte-rate header.

This project is not affiliated with Nintendo Co., Ltd.
Animal Crossing is a copyright of Nintendo Co., Ltd.
